meta.calibrationRule: budget = min(Good, baseline_max * 1.25), floored at half of Good (never tighter than Good/2 so ordinary lab variance does not flap, never weaker than Good per the spec).
meta.measurementMethod: Lab: headless system Chrome (channel 'chrome'), 4x CPU throttle (CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate), fixed 1366x768 viewport, no-backend reference mode (production SSR build started with a dead GATEWAY_URL so API calls 502 and validateSession fails open), scripted interactions after waitForLcpStable. web-vitals v6 (same metric definitions as the RUM pipeline at /api/v1/rum). Percentile target: p75.
meta.metricDefinitions: LCP (ms), INP (ms), CLS (unitless) exactly as reported by web-vitals v6 onLCP/onINP/onCLS — identical to the values RUM reports.
